description: The last lit thing on Meltwater Row before the road gives up, and the only front on it that was built to be looked at. It went up as a music hall: cream faience between oxblood pilasters, three tall round-headed windows where the circle bar was, and a copper dome on each corner like a pair of hatpins. Behind it the stage house climbs two storeys past the roof. MIDWAY PARKS runs across the front in tubes, and off the corner a blade four storeys tall spells CINEMA downwards, a third of its bulbs out in a pattern that hasn't changed in years. Under it all a canopy on chained rods, lamps let into its underside, over glazed doors with brass push-plates worn to the white metal. The letter board reads NOW SHOWING · THE METER READER · 8PM ONLY, and has read it long enough to fade round the letters.
name: Midway Parks Cinema
